content.value_statement: Market analysis requires extensive research, structured frameworks, visuals, and professional formatting. This skill guides Claude and Codex through comprehensive LaTeX reports and PDFs.
actual_capabilities: Defines a report structure covering executive findings, market sizing, competition, customers, technology, regulation, risks, recommendations, implementation, and financial projections.
Guides market data collection, source organization, citation, assumption tracking, and cross-source validation.
Applies TAM, SAM, SOM, Porter's Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, positioning, risk, and prioritization frameworks.
Provides prompts for growth charts, market maps, risk heatmaps, roadmaps, and strategic matrices.
Includes a LaTeX report template, style package, formatting guide, and PDF compilation workflow.
limitations: Research, image generation, peer review, and citation workflows depend on separate skills and tools.
Users must verify source quality, market estimates, projections, and licensing before relying on the report.
The templates contain illustrative values and structures that require market-specific evidence.
The bundled batch visual script has tuple handling defects and may require correction before execution.

use_cases.title: Plan a market entry
use_cases.description: Assess market size, customer segments, competitors, risks, and prioritized entry options.

use_cases.title: Evaluate an investment
use_cases.description: Build a sourced industry view with scenarios, financial assumptions, and an investment thesis.

use_cases.title: Develop a growth strategy
use_cases.description: Identify attractive segments, product opportunities, implementation phases, and measurable success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create a market overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a market overview for [MARKET] in [REGION]. Define scope, stakeholders, value chain, history, current dynamics, and key data gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner overview for a clearly defined market

prompt_templates.title: Size and segment a market
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate TAM, SAM, and SOM for [MARKET]. State assumptions, compare sources, segment demand, calculate growth, and distinguish historical data from projections.

prompt_templates.title: Build a complete research report
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a comprehensive report on [MARKET] for [AUDIENCE]. Include sourced analysis, strategic frameworks, six priority visuals, recommendations, implementation phases, limitations, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an investment under uncertainty
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [MARKET] for [INVESTMENT DECISION]. Compare base, optimistic, and conservative scenarios. Stress-test assumptions, quantify risks, rank opportunities, and define decision triggers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert due diligence and scenario analysis

output_examples.input: Assess the European electric vehicle charging market for a 2027 market entry.
output: Executive market snapshot with sourced size, growth, and regional metrics.
TAM, SAM, and SOM model with explicit assumptions and sensitivity ranges.
Competitor map, regulatory timeline, risk heatmap, and phased entry roadmap.

output_examples.input: Analyze cloud security platforms for an investment committee.
output: Competitive landscape using Five Forces, market shares, and strategic groups.
Base, optimistic, and conservative financial scenarios with stated uncertainties.
Investment thesis, key risks, diligence questions, and measurable decision triggers.

output_examples.input: Develop growth options for a renewable energy storage provider.
output: Segment attractiveness analysis covering size, growth, profitability, and ability to win.
Prioritized opportunities with required investment, expected returns, and risk mitigations.
Implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, dependencies, resources, and governance.

best_practices: Define market boundaries, geography, audience, and forecast horizon before collecting data.
Cite every statistic, compare independent sources, and separate observed data from assumptions.
Review generated visuals, calculations, references, and recommendations before distributing the PDF.
anti_patterns: Do not treat illustrative template values as verified market evidence.
Do not present unsupported projections or precise market shares without assumptions and sources.
Do not generate a long report before confirming scope, decision criteria, and available data.

faq.question: What output does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It guides creation of a structured LaTeX market report that can compile into a professionally formatted PDF.

faq.question: Does it collect current market data automatically?
faq.answer: It provides a research workflow, but current data collection depends on separate research tools and accessible sources.

faq.question: Which analysis frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: It covers TAM, SAM, SOM, Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, positioning, segmentation, risk, opportunity, and implementation frameworks.

faq.question: Can it generate charts and diagrams?
faq.answer: It provides detailed visual prompts and a batch script that integrates with separate diagram and image generation skills.

faq.question: Are the market estimates guaranteed to be accurate?
faq.answer: No. Users must validate sources, assumptions, calculations, projection ranges, and any claims used for business decisions.

faq.question: What software is required for PDF output?
faq.answer: A LaTeX environment with XeLaTeX and BibTeX is required, along with the included template and style package.
